Spider_Phase_Queen
The Phase Spider Matriarch is a type of Monstrosity creature in Baldur's Gate 3. It is a boss encounter in the Whispering Depths and possesses several powerful abilities.
“
In Her form I find ecstasy. The spell is not enough.
„
— Eliette, on her transformation

Overview

History

The phase spider matriarch was once an arachnomancer named Eliette[1] and worshipper of Lolth. She wished to transform so as to "refashion myself in the Queen's image".[2]

Combat

Attacks and actions

 Ethereal Jaunt ()

Surrounded by silver mist, you teleport to an unoccupied space you can see.

 Range: 22 m (73 ft)
 Recharge: Per turn
 Matriarch's Call ()

The spider matriarch calls on her brood, causing her nearby eggs to hatch.

 Range: 3 m (10 ft)
 Recharge: Every 2 turns
 Spider Queen's Wrath

Gain one additional attack per turn. Increase Strength by 2, while  Armour Class is reduced by 1.
Tactician Difficulty: Gain one additional attack per turn. Increase Strength by 2 and grant Resistance to physical damage.

 Range: Self
 Recharge: Per combat

Damage: 10~37
2d6⁠Poison

Deals 2d6Poison damage and 1d8+4Piercing damage, and possibly injects a venom that deals 2d6Poison damage.

Honour mode

In honour mode only, the matriarch and her Phase Spiders will all have See Invisibility.

 Gossamer Tomb
Damage: 10~80
10d8⁠Poison

Entomb a creature that attacks your offspring with an  Infested glob of web.

Unless removed with Fire or Acid damage, this glob of web will eventually explode, dealing 10d8⁠⁠Poison[See: Bugs] to the entombed creature.

 DEX Save
 Range: 30 m (100 ft)
 Recharge: Per turn

Allies

  •  Phase Spider - 2x
  •  Phase Spiderling - 17x, maximum possible, in 3 groups of 6, 6, and 5.

Encounter details

  • When combat begins, the Matriarch attempts to hatch her nearby Phase Spiderling eggs. There are three groups of 6 spider eggs scattered throughout the chamber, two on top of the large stone platforms and one at the base of a platform.
  • The Phase Spider Matriarch uses its phase abilities to teleport around the arena.
  • At 50% or less Hit Points, the Matriarch casts  Spider Queen's Wrath on itself, entering into an enraged state.
  • Knocking the Phase Spider Matriarch into one of the side holes labelled 'Chasm' kills her and grant the party 250xp. However, knocking her into the centre hole (not labelled 'Chasm') does not grant experience, but its corpse can be found in the Underdark (X:140 Y:151) to loot and possibly animate with  Glut. On Tactician and Honour mode, the Matriach cannot be knocked into any of these drops since it just teleport back to its former location.
  • The Phase Spider Matriach has +1 bonuses to Strength and Dexterity on Tactician difficulty, with resultant bonuses to Initiative, Armour Class, Attack rolls, and Saving throws, making an already fairly fierce early game enemy even deadlier.

Tactics

  • The Matriarch's eggs can be destroyed before the battle begins if the party can stay hidden (which also allows for an easy Pest Control achievement). Failing that, area damage spells work well on their low Hit Points. It is preferable to destroy all the eggs in Tactician/Honour mode due to her legendary action, but in lower difficulties it can be beneficial to leave a single egg behind in a batch as the Matriarch then essentially wastes an action to summon a single Phase Spiderling. Destroying the eggs with an  Arrow of Fire destroys nearby webs even though it does not deal damage to any webs. If any webs are destroyed, a Phase spider will cast  Ethereal Jaunt to find somebody who recently touched the web.
  • In Honour mode,  Spiritual Weapon can be used to kill a Phase Spiderling and the Matriarch will then use Gossamer Tomb on the Spiritual Weapon, but due to the weapon being immune to this action, this will essentially waste the Matriarch's legendary action.
  • When the Matriarch is on a web bridge, destroying the bridge using ⁠Fire damage inflicts a significant amount of fall damage on her (~45, varying with height). The stone platforms they connect to have no loot on them and are mostly accessible even without the bridges, thus it is recommended to use this tactic whenever the opportunity presents itself.
  • Almost all of the Spider Matriarch's damage is ⁠Poison so the party can benefit from casting  Protection from Poison or drinking  Elixir of Poison Resistance before entering combat.
  •  Lump the Enlightened and his ogres can prove valuable allies in the battle. They can be recruited just up above in the Blighted Village through a Charisma check or paying them 500g. This can result in a win-win situation where Lump is killed in the battle or is significantly weakened allowing the opportunity to easily obtain the  Warped Headband of Intellect.
  • It is advisable to spread party members out. Her venomous discharge ability has a large AoE radius.

Exploits

  • The middle spiderweb bridge has a stone outcrop that, when the matriarch stands on and the bridge destroyed, effectively neutralizes her: she will be stuck in her falling down animation but never move and, therefore, never enter combat. The combat log gives experience as if she has fallen into the Underdark, but the player can still kill her normally with ranged attacks afterward — yielding the kill experience reward and loot. This was found on a tactician playthrough and should work for honour mode.
    • Kill any minions. Having other starting combat for the queen snaps her back to normal.
      • Kill the eggs then the phase spider, use  Minor Illusion to draw them away and into kill-box. Use a rogue and equip them with the  Haste Helm for hit-and-run. This should be easy, given all of them have -2 intellect saving throw.
        • Best setup location is the ledge gated by web: draw a spider into the low-ground directly below, activate combat mode first before attacking. Any location with similar advantage is also acceptable.
    • Lure the queen with  Minor Illusion to the outcrop. Attack the bridge then kill her with ranged, as going into melee triggers normal combat.
